content.text:
Evergreen Catering has two approved invoices, so I need you to tell me which one to pay before I send anything:

- **INV-53266**: $4,268.44, due 2026-11-04
- **INV-36368**: $4,549.02, due 2026-11-25

Two other invoices for this vendor aren't eligible: INV-32815 is already paid, and INV-52633 is still a draft awaiting approval. Once you confirm the invoice, I'll pay it in full by wire, falling back to ACH if wire isn't available, and make a single payment.
